description: Send a prepared order to checkout and return the payment link. Call only after the customer has seen the prepare-order-tool summary and explicitly confirmed it. All questions must be answered first. The customer opens checkout_url and pays themselves; billing address, VAT ID and taxes are handled by Stripe. The link is valid for 24 hours. Repeated calls return the same link while it is valid, or a new one after it expires. After this call the order can no longer be changed.

order_id.description: The order_id returned by prepare-order-tool, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa.

name: create-checkout-tool
title: Create checkout link
